posts.subject: External monitor does not wake up
posts.author: murrrzilka
posts.message_html:
External monitor Dell P2414H connected to Lenovo Legion 5 Pro via USB-C → DisplayPort does not wake up on cold boot. Monitor shows “No signal” until I physically unplug and reconnect the DisplayPort cable. After reconnection, the monitor works normally.

Details:

Monitor: Dell P2414H (1920×1080 @ 60Hz)
Connection: USB-C (DP Alt Mode) → DisplayPort
OS: Windows 11
Issue occurs only on startup; hot-plug always works
Disabling DP 1.2 on the monitor and Windows Fast Startup did not fully resolve the issue

Question: Is this a known BIOS / firmware or USB-C DP Alt Mode initialization issue on Lenovo Legion 5 Pro, and is there a permanent fix?

posts.subject: Re:External monitor does not wake up
posts.author: Adriel_lenovo
posts.message_html:
Hi and welcome to the Lenovo Community murrrzilka,

I understand you're experiencing an issue wherein your Dell P2414H monitor won't wake up on cold boot while plugged to your Lenovo Legion 5 Pro laptop. Based on the details provided, I recommend the following steps to address the situation:

  1. Update BIOS and Drivers: Ensure your system's BIOS and USB-C/DisplayPort drivers are up-to-date. You can use the Lenovo Vantage App to check for updates.

  2. Monitor Firmware: Verify if your Dell P2414H monitor has any firmware updates available from the manufacturer's website.

  3. Connection Testing: Test the connection with a different USB-C to DisplayPort cable to rule out cable-related issues.

  4. Power Settings: Adjust the power settings in Windows to disable USB selective suspend settings under "Advanced Power Options."

Also, check if the same thing would happen when you connect a different monitor to the laptop.

Hope this helps.

Thanks,
Adriel_Lenovo
